items.title: 56799_Red Norvo oral history interview
items.q: one of the real good bass players was with Woody Herman that worked the studios for years, was Joe Mondragon.

ctx.x: Had a little Indian blood. I don't know how much, I think it was a sixteenth or something. And on the coast, one of the real good bass players was with Woody Herman that worked the studios for years, was Joe Mondragon.
